###### Inspiration from Vedic Farming

" த்வம் பூமிர் அபோ அனலோ அனிலோ நபா "" త్వం భూమిర్ అపో అనలో అనిలో నభ "" ത്വം ഭൂമിർ ആപോ അനലോ അനിലോ നഭ "" ತ್ವಂ ಭೂಮಿರ್ ಆಪೋ ಅನಲೋ ಅನಿಲೋ ನಭಃ "" त्वं भूमिर अपो अनलो अनिलो नभः "“Tvam Bhumir Apo Analo Anilo Nabha”

![](https://24mantraorganic.com/cdn/shop/files/banner.jpg?v=1737175429&width=480)

## 24 Mantra Organic

Inspired by vedic farming rooted in ancient principles to embrace the harmony of all five elements : earth, water, fire, air, and space. Our farmers diligently nurture crops, ensuring each harvest is rich in natural vitality for your well-being. A wholesome food. The above sanskrit quote consists of 24 characters which symbolize 24 Mantra Organic.
